findings.narrativeExcerpt: The story is about Voyager 1’s close-up study of Neptune in 1989: it was the first—and remains the only—spacecraft to study the planet up close.
findings.evidenceExcerpt: In 1989, NASA's Voyager 2 became the first-and only-spacecraft to study Neptune up close.
findings.problem: The narrative identifies Voyager 1 as the spacecraft, while the source identifies Voyager 2.
findings.requiredCorrection: Replace “Voyager 1” with “Voyager 2” in the spacecraft references.
